title: Australian Cheesy Rigatoni Bake
description: A comforting and warming pasta bake inspired by Australian flavors, featuring rigatoni, cheese, and a hint of Australian spices.
instructions: Cook the rigatoni pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the diced onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Stir in the grated cheddar and mozzarella cheese until melted and well combined.
In a large baking dish, combine the cooked rigatoni pasta, cheese mixture, and diced onion.
Transfer the baking dish to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
